content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are out of reach, digital creators face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-explained-digital-creators-7|COREMERCH guide to selling]] products online. COREMERCH offers a robust solution with its sovereign commerce stacks, allowing you to deploy an operational digital store quickly and efficiently. This guide focuses on utilizing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-11|How to]]-order-database-digital-stores-what-nobody-tells|supabase]] as the order database within your setup, ensuring seamless management of transactions without reliance on conventional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment platforms often limit access based on geographic location, leaving many creators without viable options. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed with these challenges in mind, providing a direct pathway to accepting payments via cryptocurrency. By leveraging decentralized solutions like NOWPayments and integrating them with a reliable database such as Supabase, you gain complete control over your sales process without the constraints imposed by centralized platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you get started with deployment, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your front end and access to Supabase for your order database. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, which will handle backend logic, and set up a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions. Gather your digital products and prepare them for upload, as you will need to configure your store to reflect your offerings accurately.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Supabase instance to manage orders and product data. Next, integrate NOWPayments to automate payment processing. This involves setting up webhooks that will notify your system when a payment is completed, triggering delivery of digital products. Use Google Apps Script to handle interactions between your front end on GitHub Pages and the Supabase database, ensuring that data flows smoothly from transaction initiation to product delivery.
Deployment is streamlined with robust tools like GitHub and Supabase.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Test the entire flow by placing a small order using a cryptocurrency. This will allow you to verify that payments are processed correctly and that products are delivered as expected. Monitor the transaction in Supabase to ensure that order data is recorded accurately. After confirming that everything operates as intended, promote your store to your audience and begin accepting orders.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, consider ways to scale your operations. You can expand your product offerings by adding more files in Supabase and ensuring they are linked correctly to your payment system. Additionally, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. This stack provides an end-to-end tested solution, ensuring your infrastructure remains robust as your business grows.

This architecture allows you to operate independently of restrictive payment platforms, providing full control over your digital store operations.
Full control over your store means no reliance on external platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account for hosting your digital store. 2. Set up a Supabase account for managing orders and product data. 3. Configure Google Apps Script for backend logic. 4. Set up a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. 5. Upload your digital products to Supabase and link them to your payment system. 6. Test your store by processing a small transaction.

Supabase offers a powerful, scalable database solution that integrates seamlessly with your digital store. It manages order data efficiently, providing real-time updates and allowing you to focus on selling rather than technical issues.
